g.text: Amazon Cognito (partner client credentials, staff SSO federation)
Amazon API Gateway: external /v1 (WAF, usage plans, validation)
Ops interface (programs, questions, version history, approvals)
Rater Lambdas: one published version per rating_engine_version (existing, config-aware, inputs declared in code)
Rater repo CI (tests, manifest generation, compatibility check, backtest)
S3 log lake + DB exports -> Athena
Shared service layer (programs, questions, validation, config merge, payload preflight, rating orchestration, publish)
